reasoning: The icon combines the front profile of a train/subway car with a person walking away from it, clearly representing public transit commuting, station transfers, or walking from a station. It fits tasks centered on multimodal commuting, transit routing, or station-to-destination walks, though plain train or walking icons are better for pure rail bookings or exercise walks.
